sources: deep-research report 'M8 Expansion to Broader Datasets: Twelve-Hour Experimental Plan'

datasets.mosev2: train split (full GT; valid GT is first-frame only). 180 videos pre-sampled from meta only (seed 9, 40-200 frames) -> manifest by GT rule. Released 2025 -> not in SAM 2.1 (2024) training; overlap with MOSEv1 videos UNVERIFIED
datasets.vost: val split (70 videos, 5 fps annotated frames = JPEGImages), all scanned -> manifest by GT rule
datasets.lvosv2: valid; BLOCKED (Google Drive quota) at 14:11 UTC, automatic retries
datasets.pumavos_C: sealed; never transferred, inspected or run

unit_rule: scripts/m9_manifest.py docstring: first visible frame prompt, >=10 frames, crop unit, small (<1%) only, <=3 per video (seed 9), video-hash dev/conf split

arms.PCCARRY: M9 frozen: phase-correlation carry during absence

use_of_splits: FLOWVEL/FLOWCARRY/SGGL are frozen from M8 -> evaluated on ALL units (dev+conf), reported per split and per dataset. SCALE/JOINT/PCCARRY parameters are frozen now; at most ONE evidence-based revision per mechanism, developed on dev only and judged on conf only.

stage1_gates.search: GT-present co-absence recall >= 0.25 AND hits in >= 4 videos
stage1_gates.attention: B_att must beat A_cos on paired recall/hit@1 (video-cluster CI > 0), else stop attention
stage1_gates.ranking: held-out (cross-fitted by dataset/video) net benefit > 0, else not used causally
stage1_gates.R3_attention_ranker: only if candidate hits span >= 20 independent videos

failure_taxonomy.unit_of_analysis: missed frames of the machine-matched SGGL causal run: GT present and SGGL J < 0.5 (plus co-absence subset)
order: OBSERVABILITY: GT area < 0.25 x prompt area or < 64 px
SCALE: GT long side > 0.6 x crop side, or GT area > 4 x prompt area
POSITION: GT inside crop fraction < 0.5 (at usable scale)
PRESENCE_IDENTITY: otherwise (observable, in crop, usable scale) -> split absent-claim (output empty) vs wrong-target (output non-empty, J < 0.1)
failure_taxonomy.dominant: a category with >= 50% of missed-frame loss (sum of 1 - J&F) spanning >= 3 videos; otherwise MIXED

primary_endpoint: per dataset: small-unit paired dJ&F (arm - machine-matched SGGL), unit mean over frames 1..n-1, video-mean
statistics: video-cluster bootstrap 95% CI (2000), leave-one-video-out min, exact sign test over videos with |d|>0, top-1/top-2 video share of gain, worst unit, # units < -0.05; Holm across the per-dataset FLOWVEL tests
flowvel_generalizes_if: pooled new-data video-cluster CI lower bound > 0
mean > 0 in >= 2 datasets (or in the only available dataset with Holm-adjusted CI > 0)
>= 5 videos with d > +0.01 spanning >= 2 datasets when >= 2 datasets exist
top-2 video share of the gain < 50%
scale_success_if: SCALE reduces SCALE-category missed frames by >= 30% vs SGGL AND dJ&F >= 0 (dev) AND no new unit < -0.05; then confirmed on conf
joint_synergy_if: JOINT - max(SCALE, FLOWVEL) > 0 with video-cluster CI lower > 0
cheap_motion_success_if: PCCARRY dJ&F >= 0.7 x FLOWVEL dJ&F on the same units AND latency below FLOWVEL
kill_rules: negative mean, worse than simpler parent, material false reacquisition, unit < -0.05, gain from <= 2 videos, or no mechanism evidence -> stop; one justified revision max; no threshold fishing
